title: The Assessment
summary: Bram's patrol assessment was repurposed to justify the Veilscar incident. He has known for years. He has been building a counter-assessment that corrects the record. He needs witnesses and a way to file it that will not be intercepted.

phases.label: Bram explains the assessment and what was done with it

onComplete.text: 'I want to be precise about this.' He takes off his spectacles and cleans the enchanted lens. 'My assessment correctly described Veil activity in the patrol region. It did not recommend the patrol route, the timing, or the staffing decisions that led to the incident. Someone added three pages. I know who, approximately. I have been building a counter-assessment that would make the addition visible.' He puts the spectacles back on.

phases.label: Help Bram gather the evidence chain for his counter-assessment

onComplete.text: The evidence is assembled. The three added pages were written in a hand that almost matches Bram's — close enough to survive casual inspection. The spectacles identified the Veil-energy residue on the additions: the forger spent time near an active Rift breach before writing them. That is a very short list of people.

phases.label: Find a channel to file the counter-assessment that will not be intercepted

onComplete.text: Filed through the Thornwhisper Circle's legal access to the Iron Covenant's archive — which no one who would want to intercept it knows exists. Bram watches it go and is quiet for a moment. 'It will not fix what happened to the patrol. I have been very clear with myself about that.' He continues to be clear with himself about it for the rest of the act.

phases.label: Help Bram decide what to do with the eight seconds of Rift exposure

onComplete.text: He calibrates the enchanted lens to share what it sees. 'I have seventeen shelves of notes from eight seconds. You should have access to what I can see.' He begins writing shelf eighteen.

phases.label: Bram recuses himself if Rift data is used for exploitation

onComplete.text: 'I will not be party to the use of Veil data for commercial exploitation. I am sufficiently precise about my position to know this is the line.' He is not angry. He is precise.
